tasks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE reusable Emergency Shift game prop sprite. Strict vertical orthographic overhead view at exactly 90 degrees, non-pixel hand-painted flat 2D bitmap, restrained realistic material texture like the supplied STYLE REFERENCES. References are ONLY palette/material/style references, do NOT copy their object or layout. No isometric perspective, no front elevation and no visible tall side faces. Matte muted industrial cool-gray/olive-gray/off-white/wood, no glossy product render. Actual transparent RGBA background, generous empty padding, complete object not cropped. No floor, cast/drop shadow, atmospheric halo, text, logo, characters, blood, rust or damaged-state details. Manufactured construction stays coherent and mostly straight; natural subtle variation in seams, fitting and material grain, unequal practical detail placement, not sterile catalogue perfection. Only neutral local surface relief, no baked directional light. Subject: A low-profile broad double-width steel storage cabinet intended with its straight BACK edge against a wall. Floor footprint about 125 cm wide by 55 cm deep, landscape top plan. Visible opaque closed top lid of warm pale-gray powder-coated metal, narrow dark edge trim and hinge/door-lip details only at the FRONT lower edge, coherent actual top view rather than showing door fronts. Two discreet outward projecting handles visible in plan at the front corners. Small asymmetrically placed stamped reinforcing seam on top, restrained manufacture. Empty roof, no objects placed on it. One closed cabinet, enough corner and handle detail to distinguish it from a plain rectangle.
